title: 3M-CPSEED：An EEG-based Dataset for Chinese Pinyin Production in Overt, Silent-intended, and Imagined Speech
description: 3M-CPSEED is an EEG dataset recorded from 20 healthy native Chinese speakers performing Chinese Pinyin production in overt, silent-intended, and imagined speech conditions. The stimulus set of selected finals and initials covers key articulatory features of the Chinese phonological system. The dataset supports research on speech neurophysiology, neural differences across pinyin articulations, and transfer learning to other alphabetic languages.
methods_description: Twenty right-handed native Chinese speakers (mean age 24.55 years) read Pinyin syllables presented on a screen and produced them in overt, silently articulated, and imagined phases. Stimuli comprised finals (a, i, u, ü) and initials (m, f, j, l, k, ch). Each participant completed 4 blocks totaling 1600 trials. Labeled and preprocessed data are provided in MAT format alongside the BIDS structure.
